test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Rohit did not slap Kunal.

options.text: Kunal was not being slapped by Rohit.
Kunal had not been slapped by Rohit.
Kunal was not slapped by Rohit.
Kunal has not been slapped by Rohit.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Rohit did not slap Kunal."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "Kunal" at the beginning.
